Can you get a sick leave certificate for BPO employees online?

Yes. DrCertificate lets BPO employees in 10 South East Asian countries request a sick leave certificate online. An MBBS, MD or MS doctor holds a chat consultation and decides whether to issue a certificate confirming you were unfit for work on stated dates. Approved certificates arrive by email as a PDF, and your employer decides whether to accept it.
Before you apply
What is a sick leave certificate for BPO employees?

A sick leave certificate for BPO employees is a medical note from a doctor stating that the employee was unwell and unfit to work for a stated period. The certificate names the employee, the recommended leave dates and the issuing doctor.
BPO and call centre companies often ask for one because missed shifts affect queue coverage, schedules and attendance records. One absent agent on a night shift can leave a team short until morning.
A certificate is not a diagnosis or a treatment plan.

DrCertificate does not diagnose, treat or prescribe. The independent doctor only decides whether your reported symptoms justify a sick leave certificate. For any care you need, see a local doctor or clinic.
When do BPO employees need a sick leave certificate?

items: BPO employees usually need a sick leave certificate when they miss a scheduled shift because of illness and the attendance policy asks for proof. Common triggers include a fever that starts before a night shift, a stomach upset during a split schedule, or a voice problem that makes calls impossible.

Shift work adds its own pressure. In the Philippines, the Department of Labor and Employment handbook describes night shift differential as an extra 10 percent of the regular wage for each hour worked between 10 p.m. And 6 a.m. Missing a graveyard shift can affect that pay. HR teams often want paperwork before marking the absence as paid sick leave.
Absences next to rest days or holidays draw questions too. So do missed shifts during peak campaigns or account training.
Check your company handbook for the number of absence days that triggers a certificate requirement. One account may ask after a single day while another waits until the second.

blocks.text: Which illnesses can a doctor consider for a sick leave certificate for BPO employees?

items: A doctor can consider common short term, non emergency illnesses for a sick leave certificate for BPO employees. Typical examples are colds, flu and sore throat. A doctor can also look at loss of voice, headaches, migraines and mild stomach upsets.
Headset work makes a lost voice a real reason to stay off the phones.
Each request is judged on its own. The doctor may decline if the symptoms and details shared do not match, or if a chat consultation is not enough to assess your condition.
Chest pain, trouble breathing, fainting or heavy bleeding need in person care right away. Go to the nearest emergency department or call your local emergency number.

What does a sick leave certificate for BPO employees cost?
A sick leave certificate for BPO employees costs 399 pesos in the Philippines, 25 SGD in Singapore and 30 MYR in Malaysia. The price in other served countries depends on location.
The fee pays for the doctor's review and chat consultation, plus email delivery of the PDF if approved. Payment goes through Stripe.
All payments are non refundable, including when the doctor declines your request. The only exception is a verified technical fault reported within 24 hours.

What should BPO employees check before applying?

items: 1 Step 1: BPO employees should check that their employer accepts online medical notes before applying, because acceptance is always the receiving organisation's decision. A quick message to HR or your team lead can save you a fee.

2 Step 2: Ask some direct questions. Does the company accept a PDF certificate from an online doctor? Is there a deadline after you return to work? Do you upload it to a portal or email it to your supervisor?

3 Step 3: Leave rules differ across the 10 countries DrCertificate serves. In the Philippines, the DOLE handbook gives employees with at least 1 year of service 5 days of paid service incentive leave, usable for sick leave, with listed exceptions. Your company may give more. Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand follow their own laws.
4 Step 4: Have your ID, the exact leave dates and a short description of your symptoms ready.
5 Step 5: Enter your name as shown on your ID. A certificate cannot be corrected once issued unless the error came from the medical team.

blocks.text: When is an online sick leave certificate for BPO employees not the right choice?
An online sick leave certificate is not the right choice in an emergency or when you need medical care. For severe or sudden symptoms, call your local emergency number or go to the nearest hospital.
The certificate cannot be used for insurance, legal purposes or submission in India. Applicants must be at least 16.
DrCertificate offers no video or in person consultations, and the platform does not diagnose, treat or prescribe. If your employer insists on a note from a clinic visit, book one locally instead.
Who reviews your BPO sick leave certificate request?
Independent certified doctors with an MBBS, MD or MS degree review every sick leave certificate request on DrCertificate. All doctors on the platform are registered with a medical council.
Each doctor decides whether to issue a certificate. Doctors decline about 2 percent of requests, usually when the name and ID do not match or when the symptoms and details shared are inconsistent.
DrCertificate, operated by Health Venture OU, handles the online form, the Stripe payment and email delivery of the PDF. The platform never makes the medical decision.

Frequently asked questions about the sick leave certificate for BPO employees
Will my BPO employer accept an online sick leave certificate?

Acceptance depends on your employer, and DrCertificate cannot promise it. Each company sets its own attendance and documentation rules. Ask HR or your team lead whether a PDF from an online doctor is accepted before you pay, because payments are non refundable even when a certificate is issued.
How long can the sick leave on the certificate be?

In most South East Asian countries, sick leave notes go up to 7 days for generic symptoms. The doctor sets the actual dates after the chat consultation, based on what you report. Longer absences or serious symptoms call for an in person assessment with a local doctor.
Can the certificate cover a shift I already missed?

The doctor decides which dates the certificate covers. Explain on the form when your symptoms started and which shifts you missed. If the doctor cannot support earlier dates from a chat consultation, the certificate shows only the dates the doctor accepts, or the request is declined.
What happens if the doctor declines my request?

If the doctor declines, no certificate is issued and the payment is not refunded. Doctors decline about 2 percent of requests, usually because the name and ID do not match or the symptoms shared are inconsistent. Check every detail on the form before you submit.
Can I get a certificate to work from home instead of going on sick leave?

Yes, if a doctor agrees it is suitable. Choose the Work From Home option on the form instead of the Sick Leave option. A work from home note can fit agents who can take calls remotely but should not commute, and it goes up to 7 days for generic symptoms.
Is the certificate accepted in the Philippines and other South East Asian countries?

DrCertificate serves BPO employees in 10 South East Asian countries, including the hubs of Manila, Cebu and Davao in the Philippines. The receiving employer decides whether to accept the certificate, and it cannot be submitted in India. Check your company policy before you apply.
